description: Amenaza de Inundación Período de Retorno 100 Años Centros Poblados is a series of datasets listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Instituto de Hidrología, Meteorología y Estudios Ambientales - IDEAM, Bogotá D.C.. Mapas de zonificación de amenaza por inundación para un período de retorno (TR) de 100 años en 79 centros poblados; muestran las amenazas existentes, clasificadas como baja, media o alta. La frecuencia de actualización se realizará de manera eventual. Coverage: Colombia. The portal lists 5 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Instituto de Hidrología, Meteorología y Estudios Ambientales - IDEAM, Bogotá D.C.. Its tags are amenaza, inundacion. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible. The portal shows 2025-08-05 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
